_comment: Shared blocks a feature uses, and setup data an API step loads with TestDataLoader.forKey(key). A request is the API body as it is.

API-SETUP-TRADE-CREATE._comment: Body of POST /trades/create?tradeAction=SUBMIT (part 'trade'), as copied; productId is set from the product

UI-SETUP-RISK-CALC-NEW-SUCCESS._comment: Answer of a mocked risk calculation (riskEngine=mock): RESP-TPL-MOCK-DATA-UI-001 with this entry's data

SETUP-USER-PREFERENCE-CONFIG-DEFAULTS._comment: Body of PUT /uc/api/user-preferences, sent for maker and checker before every @playwright scenario (E2EScenarioHooks); the values of the replay project (framework/api/user-preferences.api.ts)
